book.name: Vatomwe
book.title: Jisas Krais Le Vatomwe Weya Jon

content: Sip Nariye i raka monjemonje ghepirɨninji
Mbaŋa Sip Nariye i tabeya monjemonje ghepirɨninji, ma tembe bigi regha laiye e buruburu mbaŋa le molamolao ŋgoreiya lughawoghawo vaŋgothiye.
Amba ya thuweya nyaoko thovuthovuye theghepirɨ thɨ ndeghathɨ Loi e ghamwaema, na thɨ vilambwa mema, tembe vwarapirɨva.

Nyao thovuye reghava, i thɨna gaeba thɨ vakatha e gol na i mena i ndeghathɨ e ghamba vowo ghadidiye. Inisenɨs lemoyo Loi i giyawe na i ŋambu vatabo raloŋweloŋweghathɨko wolaghɨye lenji naŋgo e ghamba vowo gol ina e ghamba yaku vwenyevwenye ghamwae.
Amba inisenɨs munduwae i voro weiye raloŋweloŋweghathɨko lenji naŋgo, thɨ mena weya nyaoma thovuye iya i ndeghathɨ Loi ghamwaema.
Nyaoko thovuye i thɨna gaebako na i wa e ghamba vowoko, ve takombana vowoko ŋiyawe, na weiye le vurɨgheghe i liŋginjoŋa e yambane. Amba mbɨlerɨrɨ laiye, vivilema na ragheragheghe thɨ yomara.
Amba nyao thovuthovuye theghepirɨ thɨ vivatha lenji mema vwarapirɨ na thɨ uwi.

Kaero nyaoko thovuye regha i uwiya le mema na mbaŋara bigibigike thiyake thɨ yomara; uye ŋgoreiye varɨ na ndɨghe i mbumbu weiye madibe, weiye le vurɨgheghe i liŋginjoŋa e yambaneke. Yambaneke valɨvaŋga regha ŋgoreiya wan ted (1/3) i nda, umbwaumbwa tembe ŋgoreiyeva na nanako wolaghɨye thɨ ndavao.
Na nyao thovuye theghewoniye i uwiya le mema, amba bigi regha ŋgoreiya ou laghɨye regha i rara ve dobu e njighɨko tɨne. Njighɨ valɨvaŋga regha ŋgoreiye wan ted (1/3) i gharavɨ na madibe,
thetheghan e njighɨko tɨne lenji ghanaghanagha ŋgoreiye wan ted (1/3) thiya mare, na waŋga tembe wan tedɨva (1/3) i mukuwoŋgi.
Nyao theghetoniye i uwiya le mema, amba ghɨtara laghɨye regha i ra ŋgoreiye theŋgi i rara i dobunjama e buruburuko, i unja e walawalaghɨta ŋgoreiye wan ted (1/3) na mbwarowou weŋgi.
Ghɨtarako iyako idae maŋgamaŋga. Mbwako wolaghɨye valɨvaŋga le ghanaghanagha ŋgoreiye wan ted (1/3) thɨ maŋga, na gharɨgharɨ lemoyo thɨ muna maŋgamaŋgako na thɨ mare.

Amba nyao theghevarɨninji i uwiya le mema. Varae, manjala na ghɨtara bigi regha i vakowanaŋgi na mbala ma thɨ mbɨle mbaŋa valɨvaŋga le laghɨlaghɨye ŋgoreiye wan ted (1/3). Mava varae i mbɨle valɨvaŋga le laghɨlaghɨye ŋgoreiye wan ted (1/3) ghararaghɨye, na manjala na ghɨtara ma thɨ mbɨle ŋgoreiye wan ted (1/3) gougou.

Amba ya tagathɨna maraŋgu, na ya thuweya malaghɨ i yoyo e lughawoghawoko na ya loŋweya ghalɨŋae laghɨye, iŋa, “Aleu, o tharɨ! Aleu, o tharɨ! Tharɨ ne thɨ yomara weŋgiya rameyambane, mbaŋa ne nyaoko thovuthovuye theghetoko thɨ uwiya lenji memako. Maiyavarake!”
